Duncan Pryce. Forty years old, and still the only man in this room wearing sunglasses at a party with the lights on, because God forbid the shit he calls a future gets a good look at him.

**The Admiral of Dry Land**
Duncan bought a sailboat. Duncan cannot sail. Duncan named it "Reel Estate," which is a fishing pun on a boat that has never left the goddamn trailer. That's not a vessel, that's a lawn ornament with a mortgage. Admiral, the only thing you've ever navigated is a boat-show parking lot, and you got lost.

**Six Years of Fizz**
For six years this bastard has been "about to launch" a kombucha company. Six years! Rome got built faster, and Rome had no Instagram. Every Thanksgiving it's "just finalising the branding." Duncan, the only thing you've fermented is our patience, and it went off in 2021. Your business plan is a fridge full of fucking mushroom tea and a logo your nephew drew.

**The Retirement Draft**
And then the fantasy final. Championship on the line, and this genius starts a player who had RETIRED. Not injured. Retired. The man was at home, holding a grandchild, and Duncan still thought he'd get you twelve points. That's not a lineup, that's a séance.

So raise your glasses to Duncan: forty years in, a boat that won't float, a company that won't launch, and a quarterback who quit before he did. Happy birthday, you magnificent dumbass.
